sec-head.p: Each layer of a production multimodal pipeline, built and tested as its own verifiable stage.

card.p: Building pipelines to ingest, align, and preprocess text, image, and audio data. This step determines the ceiling on multimodal model performance.
Selecting and configuring the right fusion approach (early, late, or hybrid) and backbone models (CLIP, LLaVA, Whisper) for your use case and latency requirements.
Building a retrieval layer that indexes images, transcripts, and documents, enabling the model to ground its outputs in verified external sources.
Configuring the generation layer with grounding constraints, confidence thresholds, and defensive fallback so the system says 'I do not know' instead of hallucinating.
Testing cross‑modal reasoning, retrieval quality, and generation fidelity using benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, VQA) and your real queries, with transparent results.
Deploying the full multimodal pipeline as a versioned, monitored API integrated with your product or internal tools.
